Message.Name: Series Update
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on Sapphire for the current session on the cloud associated for this connection

Field.Name: Product Add/Update Time
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on Sapphire system today

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Sapphire Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. e.g.: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. e.g.: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted option

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long term option

Field.Name: Active on Sapphire
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on Sapphire in the current session

Field.Name: Sapphire BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Sapphire

Field.Name: Order Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Order acceptance as per Sapphire rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Member

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable. Optional: If this is filled with spaces, this ARM protection setting will be used as a default setting for this MPID

Field.Name: Allowable Engagement Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage of order size at which the Member wants Sapphire to trigger ARM protection for this underlying. Minimum value is 1 (1%). Maximum is 65,535 (65,535%)

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) in which Engagement percentage is calculated in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying. Allowable Range: 100 to 15,000 milliseconds

Field.Name: Market Maker Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Market Maker Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Away Market Maker Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Away Market Maker Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Broker Dealer Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Broker Dealer Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Firm Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Firm Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Priority Customer Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Priority Customer Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Non-Priority Customer Origin Multiplier
Field.Description: Contra side Non-Priority Customer Origin Multiplier. Valid value range: Please refer to Regulatory Circular

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: ARM Settings Update Response
Message.Description: Sapphire uses this format to respond to the firm with a status of their ARM protection settings request

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Member

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying sent in the request. Firms can use this to know which underlying setting did not take into effect in case of an error

Field.Name: ARM Settings Update Status
Field.Description: ARM settings update status

Message.Name: ARM2 Underlying Level Protection Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM2 Underlying Level protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM2 protection is applicable

Field.Name: ARM Threshold Count
Field.Description: Number of ARM triggers for the Counting Period for the specified underlying that will trigger ARM2 Underlying level protection. Minimum: 3 Maximum: 99

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) for which ARM triggers are counted in order to determine if they don't exceed the specified ARM2 Threshold. Allowable Range: 1000 to 24,300,000 milliseconds

Message.Name: ARM2 Underlying Level Protection Settings Update Response

Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Message.Name: Complex Binary Order Request
Message.Description: This is the format for a Complex Binary Order message that can be sent to match with a resting Complex orders on the complex book

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm for this request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Client Send Time
Field.Description: Firm's send time for the complex binary order. Nanoseconds since Epoch

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Sapphire Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day. ID is not unique between Series Product ID

Field.Name: Time in Force
Field.Description: Time in Force for complex binary order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net limit price for the strategy. If Side is B, a positive number represents net debit and a negative number net credit; if Side is A, a positive number represents net credit and a negative number a net debit. Price of zero is net neutral transaction for either side

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of times to execute the specified strategy

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of complex binary order

Field.Name: Stock Sell Short Indicator
Field.Description: Sell Short indicator if this complex binary order sells the stock leg of the strategy

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Complex Binary Order Response
Message.Description: This message indicates if the complex binary order is accepted or rejected. Note that this message does not report executions

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID for complex binary order if accepted; Zero if complex binary order was rejected

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Order Instruction
Field.Description: Order instruction. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: MVP
Field.Description: Number or price levels up to which the order will trade from the initial market price at time of arrival. Negative value indicates MEO to use Exchange default value. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit order price. Max Price: Defined in Regulatory Circular. Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Max size: 999999. Replaceable: Y

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side. Replaceable: N

Field.Name: SLAP Codes
Field.Description: Optionally associates each liquidity with up to 8 SLAP codes when corresponding bit is set. Replaceable: Y

Struct.Name: Standard Binary Order Cancel
Struct.Description: Firms can use this format to send a single Cancel of a Standard Order in the Liquidity Unit field of the Bulk Liquidity message

Field.Name: Liquidity Unit Type
Field.Description: Liquidity unit type (C)

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client order ID of the cancel request. Must be unique for the MPID. 0 results in a reject

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Sapphire assigned ID of the Member

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Product ID mapped to a given Option assigned by the Sapphire for the current session

Field.Name: Target Client Order ID
Field.Description: If an Order with this Target Client Order ID is found for the same MPID, this cancel is processed and the Target Client Order is canceled. If not, this cancel is rejected

Group.Name: Liquidity Units
Group.Description: 1 to 25 single-side Order, cancel or replace

Field.Name: Liquidity Unit
Field.Description: Can contain 1 AutoReplace Order, Standard Order, Standard Order Cancel or Standard Order Replace in each unit. Number of units should match the count specified in the count field

Field.Name: Order status
Field.Description: Order status

Field.Name: Engine Sequence Number
Field.Description: Unique Sequence number, assigned by the Sapphire Matching Engine, for orders processed successfully and zero if rejected

Field.Name: Engine Transaction Time
Field.Description: Unique timestamp, assigned by the Sapphire Matching Engine, for orders processed successfully and zero if rejected

Field.Name: Open Size
Field.Description: Indicates the remaining size open after processing the new order, cancel/replace or cancel. Zero for rejected orders

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Option leg: Sapphire Defined Series. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Leg Ratio Qty
Field.Description: The ratio of this individual leg. Number of option contracts or Number of stock shares for this leg is: LegRatioQty * Size

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: The side of this individual leg

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use
